articles.headline: Longtime Steelers player, assistant coach Dick Hoak dies at 86
articles.description: Dick Hoak, who spent more than 45 years with the Pittsburgh Steelers as a player and then an assistant coach, winning five Super Bowl rings along the way, has died at age 86.

images.name: Hoak_Dick 140614 [600x400]
images.caption: Dick Hoak ran for 3,965 yards and 25 touchdowns in 10 seasons in the Steelers' backfield, leading the then-struggling club in rushing three times.
